main_body: A saddle in side profile (pommel on the left, cantle on the right, dip between) resting on a horizontal brown rail with two dark legs below.
top_band: none: the peach saddle shape (rows 9-17) is a side-profile silhouette. The only horizontal surface is a 1-2 row lighter edge on the rail at rows ~19-20.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: the peach saddle body (rows ~13-17) is a vertical flank with studs and stitching. Its dip is a profile edge, not a seat surface seen from above. The rail below has only a 1-2px lighter edge before the dark front, and the legs and foot beam show no top faces. The drawing is a side elevation with no real horizontal surface visible from above, so it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The saddle uses about 3-4 peach/tan steps and 3 browns for the rail and legs. Outlines are dark brown, tinted to the material, which is correct. Texture is limited to a few studs and highlight dots. The peach flank and the legs are flat fills of about 5x5 px or more. The piece is clearly thinner and flatter than the roofed well and the cheese stall, which carry many more colours and grain per tile.
